name: Wikimedia APIs - meta.wikimedia.org (global accounts) and pt/en Wikipedia (contributions)
tier_rationale: Wikimedia Foundation, Inc., an established non-profit with published terms of use, API etiquette and a privacy policy (A8 trusted). Council P120 cond 1: registry provider wikimedia, tier trusted, terms open.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for the account records and edit metadata it serves (CentralAuth global accounts, usercontribs); attributing an IP edit to an organisation is low confidence (shared NAT, VPN, dynamic addressing) and IP edits are historical where logged-out editing is closed or masked.

error_markers.reason: Wikimedia API: replication lag above maxlag=5 (error object in HTTP 200): could not verify

globaluserinfo.title: CentralAuth meta=globaluserinfo on meta.wikimedia.org (home wiki, global registration, edit count, merged local accounts, locked flag)

terms.quote: Module username_social/wikimedia: meta.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&meta=globaluserinfo (home wiki, edit count, registration) and list=usercontribs (uclimit <= 50) on pt.wikipedia.org and en.wikipedia.org; uciprange for CIDR inputs. Hosts: meta.wikimedia.org, pt.wikipedia.org, en.wikipedia.org. Registry provider wikimedia: tier trusted, terms open.

globaluserinfo.notes: Quote: binding council text (P120 cond 1); research C0277 (verified_live 200 in the research sweep; the 2026-11-26 prep got 429 on the first request with a generic UA). guiprop=merged|unattached|editcount, formatversion=2, maxlag=5 (P120 cond 5). Only counts and dates are kept: groups, per-wiki topic data and full histories never are (P120 cond 4, LGPD art. 11). Usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review before default use (A3 BR8).

usercontribs.title: list=usercontribs on pt.wikipedia.org and en.wikipedia.org by user, IP (ucuser) or CIDR (uciprange), uclimit <= 50, without edit summaries

terms.quote: Module username_social/wikimedia: meta.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&meta=globaluserinfo (home wiki, edit count, registration) and list=usercontribs (uclimit <= 50) on pt.wikipedia.org and en.wikipedia.org; uciprange for CIDR inputs. Hosts: meta.wikimedia.org, pt.wikipedia.org, en.wikipedia.org. Registry provider wikimedia: tier trusted, terms open.

usercontribs.notes: Quote: binding council text (P120 cond 1); research C0278 (only a 429 was seen from the datacenter egress with a generic UA). ucprop=ids|title|timestamp|sizediff|flags (edit summaries are never fetched), maxlag=5, continuation is reported, never followed (P120 cond 4). IP lookups only for analyst-typed IP seeds and org_profile CIDRs, never for pivot IPs (P120 cond 3); CIDR ranges broader than /16 (IPv4) or /32 (IPv6) are refused by the API (apierror-cidrtoobroad). Content is CC BY-SA: only metadata (titles, dates, sizes) is kept.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G05-3 (module wikimedia, P120). BINDING PROFILE_REQUIREMENTS (*.wikipedia.org, *.wikimedia.org): user_agent 'V3LUM/{version} (+{contact}) python-requests' (Wikimedia User-Agent policy, P326), sent only to these hosts; {contact} is setting contact_email (a team role mailbox, never an analyst's personal address); without it the module is SKIPPED reason_code 'config' (P120 cond 2). 1 request/s (min_interval 1.0, concurrency 1; P120 cond 5); 429 and in-200 maxlag/ratelimited errors are RATE_LIMITED (could not verify, never absent); a Retry-After above 15 s is never waited for. Wikidata (wikidata.org, www.wikidata.org, query.wikidata.org) is the separate provider wikidata.
